note: Transparent rule table for src/match.ts. No model calls: a service score is base + the weights of the signals present in the lead's enrichment, plus a category bonus when the lead's business category is naturally high-need for that service. 'signals' maps a stable signal id (see docs/leadgen/CONTRACT.md) to the points it adds. 'reasons' maps the same signal ids to a one-line clause naming that signal; clauses carry no full stop so the outreach angle stays one sentence. 'searchOrder' lists every signal gap-first; match.ts falls back to the first present signal when a service has none of its own signals.
